scope: Four previously seen seed11 HybridO/P0/W100 development circuits, uniformly selected Q/E/P/L/Cq/Bq/Rq query strategies under original terminal-layer bounding boxes and full-feedback U comparator. No per-circuit best-arm selection, no blind generalization, no historical timing ratios. P large cases use exact closure views verified separately; unsealed cases stay in declared population and are excluded from legal CPD ratios.
